supersedes: r2 (pessimistic NEEDS_REVISION: 1 HIGH + 2 LOW; optimistic APPROVE + 3 findings)
summary: r3 is a bounded spec-text + guard-citation + interception-mechanism revision. It (HIGH) states the SIX-variant aligned family explicitly and switches the integration mechanism from register-into-slot to OVERRIDE-THE-RESULT of ggml_vk_guess_matmul_pipeline (one interception point at :8239, covers all six variants, alignment-independent) with an honest fixed-32x32-tile perf caveat; (optimistic #1) corrects the patch range to the real coopmat block :4090-:4211 and adds a patch injection-site anchoring assertion; (both) corrects guard condition #11 to coopmat_acc_f32_support at :4111 (NOT :3299, which is FA_COOPMAT1 tuning) and adds the 13th condition (the 64b-indexing swap at :8241-8242, excluded and unreachable at target shapes); (LOW) states the f16-exact fixture excludes inf/nan. No new code paths; AT range AT-2985..3005 and LOC ~1650 unchanged. Everything else in r2 stands byte-exact-verified.

HIGH_pessimistic_six_variant_family_and_.finding: CREATE_MM (:4092-4104) builds SIX pipelines ({s,m,l}x{unaligned,aligned}) from TWO byte arrays (matmul_q4_k_f32_cm1_data l/m/s + matmul_q4_k_f32_aligned_cm1_data a_l/a_m/a_s, tile via spec constants); on the dominant shape aligned (:8237) is TRUE so ggml_vk_guess_matmul_pipeline (:7822-7839) returns the aligned variant. r2's register-into-slot understated this.
HIGH_pessimistic_six_variant_family_and_.fix: Override the RESULT of ggml_vk_guess_matmul_pipeline: reassign the pipeline local right after the call site (:8239), under the build flag + guard, to a single standalone AXIOM _cm1 pipeline. ONE interception point covers all six variants and is alignment-independent (l/m/s or a_l/a_m/a_s). Simpler/safer than injecting two byte arrays into six slots.
HIGH_pessimistic_six_variant_family_and_.perf_caveat_recorded_not_gated: AXIOM's kernel has a FIXED 32x32 tile; the override ignores ggml's l/m/s spec-constant tile selection. On shapes where ggml would pick the l or s tile, AXIOM's fixed 32x32 may be worse than stock ggml. Recorded in the A/B (section 6) + REPRODUCE.md; NOT gated (M3.13 concluded the NVIDIA throughput campaign).
HIGH_pessimistic_six_variant_family_and_.vendor_proof: ggml-vulkan.cpp:4092-4104 (CREATE_MM, _cm1_data + _aligned_cm1_data); :8237 (aligned = !quantize_y && ne10==kpad && ne01>8 && ne11>8); :7796 ggml_vk_guess_matmul_pipeline, tail :7822-7839 (return aligned ? mmp->a_l : mmp->l); call site :8239.
HIGH_pessimistic_six_variant_family_and_.static_at: AT-3005 golden corrected to name the aligned/l-m-s family + the interception point + the 13-condition guard

interception_mechanism.chosen: Override the RESULT of ggml_vk_guess_matmul_pipeline (reassign the pipeline local right after the call site :8239) to a single standalone AXIOM _cm1 pipeline, under #ifdef GGML_VULKAN_AXIOM_Q4K + the 13-condition guard.
interception_mechanism.why: One interception point covers all six {s,m,l}x{unaligned,aligned} variants, alignment-independent; simpler and lower-risk than register-into-slot (which would need to shadow both byte arrays across six slots).
interception_mechanism.perf_caveat: AXIOM fixed 32x32 tile ignores ggml's l/m/s spec-constant tile selection; may be worse on shapes where ggml would pick l or s. Recorded (A/B section 6 + REPRODUCE.md), NOT gated.
